name: Guangdong Weide Information Technology CO,.Ltd.
summary: Guangdong Weide Information Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2012 and based in Guangzhou, China, specializes in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of intelligent security hardware and cloud-based information security platforms. The company offers a broad array of industrial-grade products, including Internet of Things (IoT) and protocol anti-tampering systems, secure remote access for terminals, smart industrial locks, and data security collection tools. Their portfolio also encompasses various network security solutions, such as attack prevention, control terminal management, intelligent business testing and data integration, digital distribution network tools, and 3D data visualization. Additionally, Weide Information Technology provides products for network awareness, terminal operations, and multi-factor authentication. The firm further delivers comprehensive solutions in areas like energy management, encryption, system platforms, and security auditing services.
